name: Companion Chat
description: A chat companion for Orca. Talk to the coding CLI you choose (Claude Code, OpenCode, Kimi Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI or your own) and let it start agents, create workspaces, open terminals and create files, each change only after you allow it.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Companion Chat: toggle the right sidebar (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L)

settings.title: Agent CLI
settings.description: The coding CLI the companion talks to. The panel asks on first start and its settings (gear) change it.

settings.title: Custom CLI: command
settings.description: Only for "Custom command": the executable, e.g. /usr/local/bin/mycli.

settings.title: Custom CLI: arguments
settings.description: Only for "Custom command": arguments, with {prompt} where the message goes and optionally {model}. Quote with "…".

settings.title: Extra arguments
settings.description: Added to every run of the selected CLI, e.g. --permission-mode acceptEdits for Claude Code.

settings.title: Time limit per answer (minutes)
settings.description: The CLI is stopped when one answer takes longer than this.
